summary: npm test (62 tests before my additions, 65 after) and node plan/check.mjs pass at the verified sha. clean-home, copy-not-link, no-values-logged, inert and rows are MET. fresh-project is NOT MET: it needs a fresh v2 project thread after the setup sitting, which cannot exist before merge, and no harness-v* release tag exists, so "plugin version equals the latest release" cannot hold yet. A real headless Claude Code session with a temp HOME did run the installed copy, journal one fingerprint row and one passing self-check, and show the line to the model, which is evidence the mechanism works but not the Expect line. Note for the builder: the hook tests exercise the installed copy built from committed HEAD (git archive), so a mutation only turns them red once committed.

results.command: T=$(mktemp -d); mkdir $T/home; CCP_SETUP_REF=HEAD CCP_SETUP_FETCH=0 HOME=$T/home CCP_SETUP_LOG=$T/log1 bash infra/cloud-environment/setup.sh; cp -a $T/home/.claude $T/run1; (same again, log2); diff -r $T/run1 $T/home/.claude; plus node --test verify/env-bootstrap/setup.test.mjs
results.excerpt: both runs rc=0; diff -r printed nothing (IDENTICAL), 17 files under ~/.claude (settings.json, skills/ccp-harness/...), no ccp-harness.old left. verify test "clean-home: two setup runs in an empty HOME leave identical ~/.claude trees" ok, and a second empty HOME gives the same tree. Mutation check: replacing the install mv with a symlink turned this test red too.

results.command: after setup, appended a line to plugins/harness/scripts/host.mjs and added plugins/harness/NEWFILE in the working tree, diff -r against a snapshot of $T/home/.claude/skills/ccp-harness, then git checkout; plus verify test "copy-not-link"
results.excerpt: find -type l in the installed copy: 0 symlinks; diff -r printed nothing (UNCHANGED); the new file was absent from the copy. setup.sh builds it with git archive <commit> plugins/harness packages/journal | tar -x into a temp dir, cp -a to out/, writes release.json (name, version, tag, commit, files), then mv into ~/.claude/skills/ccp-harness, so it is extracted from git, not the working tree. Mutation check: swapping the mv for ln -s turned the copy-not-link verify test red.

results.command: node --test plugins/harness/test/session-start.test.mjs, with two mutations committed temporarily and reset to the verified sha; plus the headless run under fresh-project
results.excerpt: Unmutated: 12 pass. Mutation 1 (fingerprint append disabled) turned 7 tests red. Mutation 2 (depth check made to pass) turned only the depth case red. The builder tests check one fingerprint then one selfcheck row, and each of depth/rules/copy/release failing alone, named in one sentence (e.g. "Subagent depth is 1, not 3, so subagents can't start their own subagents."). In the real headless session the journal got exactly one session.fingerprint and one session.selfcheck row.
results.mutation: plugins/harness/scripts/session-start.mjs: the append of the session.fingerprint row replaced with a no-op; and plugins/harness/scripts/selfcheck.mjs: depth check returns pass instead of fail
results.red_test: rows: an installed session writes one fingerprint and one passing self-check (and 6 more rows: tests); rows: a failing depth check is the only failure, named in one plain sentence

results.command: H=temp HOME; CCP_SETUP_REF=HEAD CCP_SETUP_FETCH=0 HOME=$H bash setup.sh; ln -s /root/.claude/.credentials.json $H/.claude/; HOME=$H CCP_HARNESS_DIR=$D node $H/.claude/skills/ccp-harness/scripts/install.mjs; cd $(mktemp -d) && HOME=$H CCP_HARNESS_DIR=$D claude -p "Quote any line in your context starting with ccp-harness" < /dev/null; cat $D/journal/sessions/*.jsonl
results.excerpt: The model quoted "ccp-harness 0.1.0: self-check passed (5 of 6 checks). Not checked: Origin has no harness release tag yet..." and the journal had one session.fingerprint (plugin.version 0.1.0, commit 77725d5, latest_release "none", depth 3, 8 rules, plugin from skills-dir) and one session.selfcheck (passed:true; settings, rules, depth, copy, journal pass; release unknown). What this shows: a real Claude Code session loads the setup-installed copy as a plugin, the hook runs, journals both rows and tells the session. What it does not show: this was not a fresh thread of the v2 project after the setup sitting (the environment stub runs setup.sh from main, which cannot hold this change until merge), and there is no harness-v* release tag, so the fingerprint cannot have a plugin version equal to the latest release (latest_release is "none") and the self-check is 5 of 6 with the release check unknown. Re-verify after merge and the first release tag.
